description: SP ENW - GIS - IDNO Polygons is a dataset listed in Electricity North West open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution network operator, published or maintained by Electricity North West. Dataset Classification - Open SP ENW - GIS - IDNO Polygons A Dataset of polygons indicating the properties receiving their energy from Independent Distribution Network Operators (IDNO), within our SP Electricity North West licence area. The polygons themselves do not define the actual boundary of any IDNO area. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Reference Data. Its keywords are GIS, IDNO, Voronoi, Polygon. The portal shows 2026-06-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-enw-open-data-portal.
